# legal-chunking

> Deterministic, extraction-agnostic, zero-dependency Python 3.12+ engine for legal document structuring, policy-aware chunking, starting-page provenance, and structured citation analysis.

## Scope and non-goals

- Core text and reference APIs require zero runtime dependencies.
- Optional extras: `legal-chunking[pdf]` (PyMuPDF) and `legal-chunking[ocr]` (PyMuPDF4LLM + externally supplied Tesseract traineddata).
- Out of scope: retrieval, ranking, embeddings, vector databases, LLMs, web services, and authoritative legal resolution.

## Public API (`legal_chunking`)

- `chunk_text(text, profile="generic", source_name="<memory>", doc_kind=None, trace=False) -> Document`
  - Plain text input; `Chunk.page` is `None`.
- `chunk_pages(pages: Sequence[ExtractedPage], profile="generic", source_name="<memory>", doc_kind=None, trace=False) -> Document`
  - Extractor-neutral page input (`ExtractedPage(page_number: int, text: str)`, 1-based `page_number >= 1`); populates `Chunk.page` with each chunk's starting page without altering `chunk_id` or `semantic_hash`.
  - Recommended entry point when integrating external extractors (Docling, Unstructured, Azure DI, custom OCR).
- `chunk_pdf(path, profile="generic", doc_kind=None, trace=False, *, backend="pymupdf", ocr="off", ocr_language="eng", ocr_dpi=300) -> Document`
  - Optional PDF adapter routing through `extract_pdf_pages` and `chunk_pages`; populates `Chunk.page`.
- `assemble_sections(text, *, profile="generic", chunk_policy="default", doc_kind=None, source_name="<memory>", trace=None) -> list[Section]`
  - Lower-level section assembly on already-normalized text.
- `extract_references(text, *, profile="generic", doc_family=None) -> list[ParsedReference]`
  - Deduplicated structured citation extraction.
- `analyze_references(text, *, profile="generic", doc_family=None) -> ReferenceAnalysis`
  - Ordered, source-anchored `ReferenceOccurrence` spans (original and normalized offsets) preserving repeated and coordinated citations.
- Models: `Document`, `Section`, `Chunk`, `ExtractedPage`, `ParsedReference`, `ReferenceAnalysis`, `ReferenceOccurrence`.
- Errors: `LegalChunkingError`, `AssetConfigError`, `InvalidProfileError`, `PdfDependencyError`, `ExtractionError`.

## Profiles and policies

- Enabled profiles: `generic`, `ru`, `us`, `eu`, `ae`.
- Policies: `default`, `statute`, `guidance`, `case_law` (selected via profile assets and optional `doc_kind`).
- Determinism: identical inputs, arguments, packaged assets, and runtime versions produce identical structure, `semantic_hash`, and `chunk_id`.

## Concurrency and async integration

- The engine is synchronous, CPU-bound, and thread-safe (immutable cached rules/patterns; `pymupdf4llm` runs in an isolated subprocess worker).
- Do not expect `async` APIs inside the library. In `asyncio` services (e.g. FastAPI), offload calls with `await asyncio.to_thread(chunk_text, ...)` or use `ProcessPoolExecutor` for CPU-bound batches.
